decisions.reason: As a trend-sensitive decorative variant launched alongside several similar options, its value should be largely revealed by 2022 and portfolio overlap makes abandonment likely if demand was not clearly strong.
This transparent burnout decorative fabric looks like a fashion-oriented niche option, and after three years a medium textile firm would likely close it if it had not shown distinctive traction.
Because it is close to other burnout/devore decorative launches, the firm would likely rationalize the range once uncertainty has resolved and keep only the best-performing design family.
A velour-like upholstery fabric fits a broader, more durable application area, so the firm has reason to keep the option open if carrying it does not impose high extra cost.
The flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric serves a functional niche where repeat B2B demand can be steadier, making continued market presence more attractive than abandonment.
A polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a relatively standard adjacent offering that can complement the established range, so keeping it is plausible unless sales were clearly disappointing.
